commits.message:
fix(pretty): a value from another realm prints as the same value made here (rich-pretty-dzzp) (#310)

* fix(pretty): a value from another realm prints as the same value made here (rich-pretty-dzzp)

describesItself compared toString against this realm's Object.prototype.toString,
and formOf/indexedElements classified Map, Set and DataView with instanceof, so
a vm-context or iframe object printed [object Object], [object Map], or (for a
DataView) an empty array. Every classification now asks the value's internal
slot through a borrowed built-in brand check, and the default-toString test
compares against the Object.prototype of the value's own realm.

The Map/Set bound tests faked a collection by grafting Set.prototype onto a
plain object; they now use real subclasses, which the brand check accepts.

* fix(pretty): brand checks see a proxied collection, take two steps not a chain walk, and cost a plain object nothing (rich-pretty-dzzp)

Review pass high on PR #310:
- isMap/isSet: instanceof first (a Proxy around a collection has the
  prototype, not the slot); the throwing slot probe only for a value whose
  toStringTag already names the kind. One isCollection helper.
- describesItself: the default toString is found from the function itself
  (its realm's Function.prototype, then Object.prototype) — no unbounded
  prototype walk, which spun forever on a self-referential Proxy, and a
  borrowed Object.prototype.toString is still a non-answer.
- threw(): reads a string message, so a foreign Error prints as one made here.
- typed-array tag getter computed once; redundant ArrayBuffer.isView dropped.

* fix(pretty): a collection the tag names is a collection, and a foreign one is never printed empty (rich-pretty-dzzp)

Review pass medium on PR #310:
- A Proxy around another realm's Map has neither our prototype nor the slot;
  the tag now admits it, and a proxy that will not open prints [Threw: …]
  instead of the answer-shaped 'Map {}'.
- A foreign subclass that renamed its tag is found by its slot; only a value
  carrying a string tag is probed, so plain objects never throw.
- Rejected: a Symbol.toStringTag getter that throws printing [Threw] — the
  value's own getter failed when asked what it is; carrying that is the
  no-silent-failure contract, and opaqueName read the same getter on master.

feat(examples): effects-feel curves rebuilt as breath, sunlight on water, wind, fireflies (rich-effects-fxiy.b6i)

Brandon's first verdict on b6i: the defaults were jerky and choppy. The loops
are now smooth noise and smooth waveforms, light mixes in OKLab instead of
round the hue circle, and the demo runs at 30 fps by default. A test bars any
loop from moving a cell more than dE_OK 0.06 between frames at 1 fps.
